table_description: The accounts table stores information about customer accounts, including account details and contact information. It uniquely identifies records using a combination of account_id, customer_id, and sscrm_customer_id.

columns.name: account_id
columns.description: Uniquely identifies records in the table, along with customer_id and sscrm_customer_id, to distinguish between different accounts.

columns.name: account_name
columns.description: Stores the name of the account, which can be used to identify or categorize the account for analytical purposes.

columns.name: account_number
columns.description: Holds the account number, which may be used for reference or tracking purposes in data analysis.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Uniquely identifies records in the table, along with account_id and sscrm_customer_id, to distinguish between different customers.

columns.name: customer_number
columns.description: Stores the customer number, which can be used to reference or track customer information in data analysis.

columns.name: sscrm_customer_id
columns.description: Uniquely identifies records in the table, along with account_id and customer_id, to distinguish between different customers in the sscrm system.

columns.name: branch
columns.description: Holds the branch information associated with the account, which can be used for geographical or organizational analysis.

columns.name: portfolio_owner
columns.description: Stores the name or identifier of the portfolio owner, which can be used to track ownership or responsibility for the account.

columns.name: primary_contact_name
columns.description: Holds the name of the primary contact for the account, which can be used for communication or relationship management purposes.

columns.name: primary_contact_email1
columns.description: Stores the email address of the primary contact, which can be used for communication or outreach efforts in data analysis.

columns.name: primary_contact_phone1
columns.description: Holds the phone number of the primary contact, which can be used for communication or outreach efforts in data analysis.
